name: Tano (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tano town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a four-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Tano, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Tano town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a four-pointed star
